408.description: Request timeout. Glean retries the delivery.

429.description: Rate limited. Glean retries the delivery.

2XX.description: Event accepted. Glean does not retry the delivery.

3XX.description: Redirects are not followed and the delivery is not retried.

4XX.description: Client error other than 408 or 429. Glean does not retry.

5XX.description: Server error. Glean retries the delivery.
